body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports a nested call as a call argument (f (g x)), closing a gap named since the earliest binary-op/plain-call work. every-call-arg-symbol-or-number? widened to accept a nested plain-call-shaped?/binary-op-call-shaped? argument, reusing existing emit-plain-call/emit-binary-op (real, terminating mutual recursion). Confirmed live via direct compile+run that mixing an I32-returning nested call into a binary-op produces genuine char*+int pointer arithmetic that still computes correctly (char size 1, bit-identical to int addition) -- not a new risk, an existing convention reaching a new position. 4 new tests including a real compile+run+assert round trip. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit d162f2c.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: nested-call-as-a-call-argument support
